checks.simulator_reading: The front's width and the sheet's long edge in the prepared scene geometry.
checks.site_reading: Width of the door, drawer or lid front, edge to edge, and the long edge of a sheet of printer paper lying flat in view while filming.
checks.threshold_basis: A careful tape reading is good to about 5 mm over 0.3 to 2 m. 2.5 cm is 1.3 to 2.5 percent of a 1 to 2 m span, inside typical reach tolerance. Website scenes currently carry estimated metres, so this is the check an unmeasured scale fails.

checks.simulator_reading: Height of handle_grasp_point_closed_world_m above the registered floor plane.
checks.site_reading: Floor to the middle of the handle, with the front closed.
checks.threshold_basis: The handle height sets the grasp point. About 2 cm separates a centred grasp from an edge or missed grasp on common handles.

checks.simulator_reading: The same free distance in the collision geometry with the joint at its upper limit.
checks.site_reading: Open floor from the fully open front straight out to the nearest obstruction.
checks.threshold_basis: Long spans with soft end points. 5 cm is small against approach clearances of 0.3 m or more and still catches a missing or phantom obstruction.

checks.simulator_reading: Prismatic travel at the joint's upper limit. For a hinge, the chord swept by the outer edge at the upper limit (2 r sin(theta / 2) from hinge_point_world_m and authored_limits_degrees) and the handle's horizontal distance from the hinge axis.
checks.site_reading: Drawer: how far the front moves when pulled out fully. Door or lid: with it fully open, straight across from its outer edge to the frame edge it closes against, and the distance from the hinge edge to the middle of the handle.
checks.threshold_basis: Opening extent fixes the joint limit the success test reads. 3 cm on a 0.4 to 1 m chord or travel is roughly 2 to 4 degrees, or 5 percent of range.

checks.simulator_reading: The same lengths recovered from a rendered RGB-D view at a capture or robot camera pose, using the scene's camera intrinsics: the appearance the policy sees, not the collision geometry.
checks.site_reading: The sheet's long edge and the front's width, from the same readings.
checks.threshold_basis: About 7 percent of a sheet edge. Catches a render whose appearance is out of scale or misaligned with the collision geometry, which the scale check cannot see.

checks.simulator_reading: Force at the handle needed to start the joint moving in the prepared scene (joint friction, detent and spring), from a quasi-static pull probe.
checks.site_reading: Peak reading of a luggage or spring scale hooked on the handle and pulled slowly until the front starts to move.
checks.threshold_basis: Untrained luggage-scale peaks vary by roughly 3 to 5 N. 10 N separates a light cabinet front (5 to 15 N) from a stiff door (30 N or more), the difference that changes the outcome.

threshold_review.proposal: AI-assisted engineering proposal of 2026-10-19. These are not reviewed values: the founder reviews them, and records the review here, before any profile is produced.
